Baseline expected failures are preserved; not counted as candidate failures.
Lease acquisition, hint lifetime and nested root-cause propagation remain outside stop diagnostics.
Started callbacks are joined; shutdown has no hard bound when providers ignore cancellation.
Browser cases are existing encryption/repair regression smoke, not browser-specific goal tests.
No SQL Server, SQLCipher, real object-store or mobile-device rerun for this slice.
No performance measurement, independent cryptographic review or ten-run release qualification.
Broader inventory/integrity budgets and durable sub-object verification remain open.
